 Fans line up in Old Town Albuquerque to meet Patrick Fabian from ‘Better Call Saul’
 Big lines formed outside and inside the Breaking Bad Store in Old Town as Patrick Fabian greeted fans and signed autographs. ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. – Big lines formed outside and inside the Breaking Bad Store in Old Town as Patrick Fabian greeted fans and signed autographs.
 Fabian appeared at the store as fans stopped by to meet the actor known as Howard Hamlin from “Better Call Saul.”
 “I love coming out and meeting anybody, anywhere. And I don’t mind it when people stop you on the street to say ‘Hey Howard!’ I think I’m really fortunate that could happen,” Patrick Fabian said.
 Fabian no longer lives in New Mexico, but he told KOB 4 that visiting feels like coming home.
 Fabian has a starring role in a movie called “Hash Tag – Under the Influence,” which premiered at the Santa Fe Film Festival, which is happening now.
 The movie’s director told KOB 4 they are looking for a distributor now.
